svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
svg.text: 10,000 people — a 99%-accurate test on a 1%-prevalent disease
Each dot = one person. Red = diseased. Gray = healthy. Orange circle = everyone who tested positive.

g.text: The dashed orange circle contains ALL 198 positives —
exactly half red, half gray. A coin flip, not a diagnosis.
This is the base-rate fallacy in one picture.

svg.text: Orange dots = the ~99 healthy people the test mistakenly flags positive. They swamp the true 99 diseased.
